title: Retrieval tuning, then generation repair and re-run

scope.purpose: Re-examine top_k and dense/sparse fusion without provider calls, then permit a bounded generation repair and paired live re-run only if the retrieval path clears the pre-registered Phase A bar.

entry_suite.source: Gate 14-R closure receipt; A0 reproduction is required before Phase A conclusions

boundaries.runtime_ml_boundary: The ONNX product path remains the shipped design; torch, transformers, and sentence-transformers are not added to requirements.txt or Dockerfile.
boundaries.frozen_research_artifacts: Gate 07 and Gate 08 protocols, baselines, metrics, datasets, research code, and measured artifacts remain read-only.

inputs.frozen_set_rule: Reuse the Gate 13-D/Gate 14-R answerable 116-question set and the same relevant_chunk_ids; do not modify the dataset or chunk store.

recommended_default_bar.rationale: A Phase A tuning result must recover at least the sparse top_k=10 control ceiling while adding dense retrieval/fusion, and must be materially above the current dense top_k=5 product default before spending provider requests.

curriculum_structure_floor.rationale: The selected default must retain the Gate 14-R dense top_k=10 rescue of this worst slice; a regression would not justify generation work.

raw_top_50_floor.rationale: The selected path must not regress the current dense raw top-50 ceiling while fusion is being changed.

pre_registered_phase_a.phase_b_entry_condition: Proceed to Phase B only if one explicitly selected, tested default configuration meets all three bars: answerable ceiling >=83/116, curriculum_structure hits >=7/15, and raw top-50 hits >=104/116. Otherwise stop after Phase A and do not issue provider requests.
pre_registered_phase_a.control_reproduction: The sparse top_k=5 row must reproduce 71/116 before lever conclusions are drawn.

metrics.answerable_ceiling: question hits/116; report raw numerator and denominator
metrics.recall_at_k: macro recall over the 116 answerable rows
metrics.precision_at_k: macro precision over the 116 answerable rows
metrics.mrr: mean reciprocal rank over the 116 answerable rows
metrics.wilson: 95% Wilson interval for question-hit and micro binary proportions
metrics.prompt_tokens: mean and p95 for the current PromptBuilder/context selection path
metrics.latency: wall-clock and per-question distribution for local retrieval-only runs

phase_a_measurements.category_slice: Report curriculum_structure as n=15 with raw hits, recall, precision, MRR, and Wilson interval for each top_k and selected fusion row.
phase_a_measurements.union_test: Measure the union of dense-only and sparse-only top-50 candidate IDs per question and compare it with fused top-50; identify all sparse-found/fused-lost questions.
phase_a_measurements.tuning_disclosure: Alternative fusion rows are diagnostic comparisons on the frozen evaluation set. Selecting a setting using these same rows is optimistic; an unbiased tuning claim would require a separately frozen held-out tuning set and a fresh evaluation set.

phase_b_protocol_requirements.frozen_question_sample: Reuse Gate 12-V's closed 40-question sample and metric definitions without rescoring its old outputs.
phase_b_protocol_requirements.groq_control: No Groq rotation. Present the owner with accept-no-control, obtain-a-higher-limit-key, or different-control-provider options and wait for a decision before live measurement.
phase_b_protocol_requirements.request_budget: At most 200 live requests total, free slugs only, paced to 20 RPM; report a running count, actual served model, and zero paid spend.
required_repairs: Propagate RAG_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS to every provider wire body.
Make RAG_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS_SOFT enforceable or explicitly rename/document it as advisory.
Fallback on typed OpenRouter HTTP-200 embedded error envelopes, including the observed 502 payload, without crossing into Groq, Ollama, or DeepSeek.
